panels.title: Energy per day - by source
panels.description: Solar = the SAU's daily generation; Mains = InteliNeo mains kWh counter; Gensets = site energy (PCC kWh counter) minus both. Set the time range to 7 days or more.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', d) AS INTEGER) + 32400 AS time, MAX(pv) AS "Solar PV", MAX(0, MAX(pcc) - MIN(pcc) - MAX(pv) - (MAX(mn) - MIN(mn))) AS "Gensets", MAX(mn) - MIN(mn) AS "Mains" FROM (SELECT date(ts, '+3 hours') AS d, CASE WHEN device_id='pv-array' AND point_id='energy_today_kwh' THEN value END AS pv, CASE WHEN device_id='neo-01' AND point_id='pcc_kwh' THEN value END AS pcc, CASE WHEN device_id='neo-01' AND point_id='mains_kwh' THEN value END AS mn FROM readings WHERE ((device_id='pv-array' AND point_id='energy_today_kwh') OR (device_id='neo-01' AND point_id IN ('pcc_kwh','mains_kwh'))) AND quality='good' AND ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S', $__from/1000, 'unixepoch') AND ts <= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S', $__to/1000, 'unixepoch')) GROUP BY d ORDER BY d
